text: The incident is closed, but Casey Lindqvist books time to scope something different: not whether the platform survived this sale, but what it would take to not even come close to a repeat next time, and what that actually costs.

Theo structures the next phase into three real workstreams: the dashboard and alert audit promised in the last lesson, the capacity question of how much headroom to carry into the next sale, and documentation and validation to make sure everything gets tested together and written down.

The capacity question can't wait for the audit to finish. Casey and Dana Whitfield already have opinions about how much headroom the platform should carry, and that conversation is about to happen on its own timeline.

This phase deliberately stays bounded: no full multi-region redesign, no replacing the existing Terraform or dashboard tooling, and no solving the capacity question by just guessing a bigger number and calling it done.
